summary: Audited latest main for build status, security risks, broken routes, configuration drift, billing/demo exposure, cron limits, and recent changes. Production remains no-go because GitHub Actions workflow runs are absent on the latest main commit even though Vercel reports success. The only actionable drift remains the unused @clerk/nextjs dependency while runtime auth is Supabase-based; issue #832 already tracks the safe package-lock regeneration path.
actions_taken: Validated there are no open PRs.
Validated latest main has Vercel success but no GitHub Actions workflow runs.
Validated vercel.json has a single cron path pointing to /api/internal/daily-maintenance.
Validated /api/internal/daily-maintenance requires internal cron authorization and forwards only the internal credential to bounded maintenance jobs.
Validated /api/ready requires HEALTHCHECK_TOKEN bearer authorization and returns no secret values.
Validated /api/prelaunch remains bounded, consent-gated, honeypot-aware, rate-limited, and no-store without public email-delivery diagnostics.

Validated /api/billing/checkout still enforces authenticated user, organization scope, manage_billing permission, trusted mutation, rate limit, step-up, Stripe metadata, audit logging, and no-store responses.
Confirmed issue #832 already tracks the safe Clerk dependency removal and package-lock regeneration path.
Recorded this audit in append-only agent_log.d because rewriting the large root agent_log.json from this connector run risks dropping historical audit entries.
next_cycle_focus: Remove @clerk/nextjs with a local Node 22/npm 10 package-lock regeneration or a dedicated PR that can run full CI/security.
Trigger or restore GitHub Actions on main so build/security are verified on the latest deployed commit.
